22600.commentary: (DNa) uḷumpan'ti pāragaman'atthāya āṇiyo koṭṭetvā kataṃ. kullan'ti valli-ādīhi bandhitvā kataṃ.

examples.text: ye taranti aṇṇavaṃ saraṃ, setuṃ katvāna visajja pallalāni, kullañ'hi jano bandhati, tiṇṇā medhāvino janā'ti.
yaṃnūn'āhaṃ tiṇakaṭṭhasākhāpalāsaṃ saṃkaḍḍhitvā, kullaṃ bandhitvā, taṃ kullaṃ nissāya hatthehi ca pādehi ca vāyamamāno sotthinā pāraṃ uttareyyan'ti.

22601.meaning2: belonging to the family; part of the home

22603.meaning2: state of a man of nobility; shallow state (of meditation)

22605.meaning1: like a boat; similar to a raft

examples.text: kull'ūpamaṃ vo, bhikkhave, dhammaṃ desitaṃ, ājānantehi dhammā'pi vo pahātabbā pag'eva adhammā.

imaṃ ce tumhe, bhikkhave, diṭṭhiṃ evaṃ parisuddhaṃ evaṃ pariyodātaṃ allīyetha kelāyetha dhanāyetha mamāyetha, api nu me tumhe, bhikkhave, kull'ūpamaṃ dhammaṃ desitaṃ ājāneyyātha nittharaṇ'atthāya no gahaṇ'atthāyā'ti?
kuso yathā duggahito, hattham'ev'ānukantati, sāmaññaṃ dupparāmaṭṭhaṃ, nirayāy'upakaḍḍhati.
pūtimacchaṃ kus'aggena, yo naro upanayhati, kusā'pi pūti vāyanti, evaṃ bāl'ūpasevanā.
498, 480. kusasm'ādī cchi.
kusa'icc'etāya dhātuyā īvibhattissa cchihoti, dhātv'antassa lopo ca. akkocchi.

22610.meaning1: Kusa thorn; sharp blade of grass

examples.text: tassa kusakaṇṭakā c'eva pāde vijjheyyuṃ, sarapattāni ca gattāni vilekheyyuṃ.

22611.meaning1: tip of a blade of Kusa grass
22611.meaning2: point of a blade of kusa
22611.commentary: (ITIa) pūtimacchaṃ kus'aggenā'ti yathā kucchitabhāvena pūtibhūtaṃ macchaṃ kusatiṇ'aggena yo puriso upanayhati puṭabandhavasena bandhati, tassa te kusā apūtikā'pi pūtimacchasambandhena pūti duggandham'eva vāyanti.

examples.text: māse māse kus'aggena, bālo bhuñjeyya bhojanaṃ, na so saṅkhātadhammānaṃ, kalaṃ agghati soḷasiṃ.
pūtimacchaṃ kus'aggena, yo naro upanayhati, kusā'pi pūti vāyanti, evaṃ bāl'ūpasevanā.

22612.meaning1: garment made from strips of kusa grass

examples.text: so sāṇāni'pi dhāreti masāṇāni'pi dhāreti chavadussāni'pi dhāreti paṃsukūlāni'pi dhāreti tirīṭāni'pi dhāreti ajinam'pi dhāreti ajinakkhipam'pi dhāreti kusacīram'pi dhāreti vākacīram'pi dhāreti phalakacīram'pi dhāreti kesakambalam'pi dhāreti vāḷakambalam'pi dhāreti ulūkapakkham'pi dhāreti
tattha dabban'ti dabbatiṇam'āha, yaṃ saddulo'ti'pi vuccati. kusan'ti kusatiṇaṃ, yo kāso'ti vuccati.

22618.meaning1: spread with blades of kusa grass
22618.commentary: (DNa) aggi pajjalito āsi, kusapattaparitthato'ti kusapattehi paritthato sappidadhimadhu-ādīni pakkhipitvā aggi jalayitum'āraddho āsi, evaṃ aggiṃ jāletvā mahājanassa dānaṃ dassāmī'ti evaṃ cintetvā ṭhitassa mamā'ti ayam'ettha attho.

examples.text: upavutthassa me pubbe, yiṭṭhu'kāmassa me sato, aggi pajjalito āsi, kusapattaparitthato.
bhagavato etam'atthaṃ ārocesuṃ. anujānāmi, bhikkhave, vikalake tosetvā kusapātaṃ kātun'ti.
evaṃ ṭhapitesu cīvarapaṭivīsesu kuso pātetabbo. tehi'pi bhikkhūhi puna kusapātaṃ katvā bhājetabbaṃ.

22620.meaning1: healthy; beneficial; useful; good; wholesome; karmically profitable
22620.synonym: atthakara, atthika, atthiya, upakāra, kalyāṇa, kallāṇa, bhadraka, vasu, sapayojana, sappayojana, sappāya, sātthaka, hita

examples.text: ime kho cunda dasa kusalakammapathā
kusalaṃ idaṃ kāyakammaṃ sukh'udrayaṃ sukhavipākan'ti, evarūpaṃ te, rāhula, kāyena kammaṃ karaṇīyaṃ.
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, gāvī pabbateyyā paṇḍitā byattā khettaññū kusalā visame pabbate carituṃ.
vicittavatth'ābharaṇā, āmuttamaṇikuṇḍalā, kusalā naccagītassa, sakkassa paricārikā.

22622.meaning1: master (of); expert (in); adept (in) familiar (with); person skilled (in)

examples.text: taṃ kiṃ maññasi, soṇa, kusalo tvaṃ pubbe agāriyabhūto vīṇāya tantissare'ti?
kāmesu n'ābhigijjheyya, manas'ānāvilo siyā, kusalo sabbadhammānaṃ, sato bhikkhu paribbaje'ti.

22623.meaning1: good; benefit; merit; good deed; doing good

examples.text: yathā'pi puppharāsimhā, kayirā mālāguṇe bahū, evaṃ jātena maccena, kattabbaṃ kusalaṃ bahuṃ.
kusalaṃ, bhikkhave, bhāvetha. sakkā, bhikkhave, kusalaṃ bhāvetuṃ. no ce'daṃ, bhikkhave, sakkā abhavissa kusalaṃ bhāvetuṃ, n'āhaṃ evaṃ vadeyyaṃ, kusalaṃ, bhikkhave, bhāvethā'ti.
tuvañ'ca bhante anukampakaṃ viduṃ, upecca vandiṃ kusalañ'ca pucchisaṃ, tato te ucchussa adāsi khaṇḍikaṃ, pasannacitā atulāya pītiyā'ti.

22626.meaning1: skillful course of action; wholesome kind of deed
22626.commentary: (PMa) dasa akusalakammapathā nāma pāṇ'ātipāto adinn'ādānaṃ kāmesumicchācāro'ti tīṇi kāyaduccaritāni, musāvādo pisuṇā vācā pharusā vācā samphappalāpo'ti cattāri vacīduccaritāni, abhijjhā byāpādo micchādiṭṭhī'ti tīṇi manoduccaritāni.

examples.text: dasavass'āyukesu, bhikkhave, manussesu dasa kusalakammapathā sabbena sabbaṃ antaradhāyissanti, dasa akusalakammapathā atibyādippissanti
taṃ kissa hetu? na h'ettha, bhikkhave, atthi dhammacariyā, samacariyā, kusalakiriyā, puññakiriyā. aññam'aññakhādikā ettha, bhikkhave, vattati dubbalakhādikā.

22628.meaning1: seeking what is good; looking for what is beneficial

examples.text: so evaṃ pabbajito samāno kiṃ kusalagavesī anuttaraṃ santivarapadaṃ pariyesamāno yena āḷāro kālāmo ten'upasaṅkamiṃ.
kiṃ pan'eso, samma sārathi, pabbajito nāmā'ti? eso kho, deva, pabbajito nāma sādhu dhammacariyā sādhu samacariyā sādhu kusalacariyā sādhu puññakiriyā sādhu avihiṃsā sādhu bhūt'ānukampā'ti.

22633.meaning1: good quality; wholesome state; skilful quality

examples.text: sādhu sādhu, bhikkhu! app'iccho so, bhikkhu, kulaputto. sante'y'eva attani kusaladhamme na icchati parehi ñāyamāne.

22634.meaning1: interest in good qualities; impulse for wholesome states; desire for skilful traits

22635.meaning1: fact of having skilful qualities; fact of having good principles; virtuousness; wholesomeness
22635.commentary: (ANa) ariye ñāye'ti sahavipassanake magge. kalyāṇadhammatā kusaladhammatā'ti'pi tass'eva nāmāni.

examples.text: idha, brāhmaṇa, bahujanahitāya paṭipanno hoti bahujanasukhāya, bahussa janatā ariye ñāye patiṭṭhāpitā, yadidaṃ kalyāṇadhammatā kusaladhammatā.

22636.meaning1: teaching good qualities; explaining wholesome states

22637.meaning1: having wholesome qualities; possessing skilful attributes
22637.commentary: (MNa) sabb'ākusaladhammapahīno kho, mahārāja, tathāgato kusaladhammasamannāgato'ti ettha sabbesaṃ'y'eva akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ pahānaṃ vaṇṇetī'ti. āma vaṇṇetī'ti vutte yathā pucchā, tathā attho vutto bhaveyya. evaṃ byākaraṇaṃ pana na bhāriyaṃ. appahīnaakusalo'pi hi pahānaṃ vaṇṇeyya, bhagavā pana pahīn'ākusalatāya yathākārī tathāvādī'ti dassetuṃ evaṃ byākāsi. sukkapakkhe'pi es'eva nayo.

examples.text: kiṃ nu kho, bhante ānanda, so bhagavā sabbesaṃ'y'eva akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ pahānaṃ vaṇṇetī'ti? sabb'ākusaladhammapahīno kho, mahārāja, tathāgato kusaladhammasamannāgato'ti.

22639.meaning1: taking up good qualities; undertaking skilful states

examples.text: evam'etaṃ, bhaddiya, evam'etaṃ, bhaddiya! sabbe ce'pi, bhaddiya, khattiyā imāya āvaṭṭaniyā āvaṭṭeyyuṃ akusaladhammappahānāya kusaladhamm'ūpasampadāya, sabbesam'pi'ssa khattiyānaṃ dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāya.
tisso kusaladhātuyo, nekkhammadhātu, abyāpādadhātu, avihiṃsādhātu.

22641.meaning1: based on wholesome states; founded on what is skilful
22641.commentary: (MNa) upekkhā kusalanissitā na saṇṭhātī'ti idha vipassan'upekkhā adhippetā. upekkhā kusalanissitā saṇṭhātī'ti idha chaḷaṅg'upekkhā, sā pan'esā kiñ'c'āpi khīṇ'āsavassa iṭṭh'āniṭṭhesu ārammaṇesu arajjanādi-vasena pavattati, ayaṃ pana bhikkhu vīriyabalena bhāvanāsiddhiyā attano vipassanaṃ khīṇ'āsavassa chaḷaṅg'upekkhāṭhāne ṭhapetī'ti vipassanā'va chaḷaṅg'upekkhā nāma jātā. (MNt) kusalanissitaṃ nimittan'ti kusalacittappavattikāraṇaṃ (MNt) kusalanissitan'ti kusalena nissitaṃ nissayitabbaṃ.

examples.text: tassa ce, āvuso, bhikkhuno evaṃ buddhaṃ anussarato evaṃ dhammaṃ anussarato evaṃ saṅghaṃ anussarato upekkhā kusalanissitā na saṇṭhāti, so tena saṃvijjati saṃvegaṃ āpajjati

22642.meaningLit: on the side of the skilful
22642.commentary: (MNa) vīsati kusalapakkhā'ti sammādiṭṭhi'ādayo dasa, sammādiṭṭhipaccayā ca aneke kusalā dhammā'ti-ādinā nayena vuttā dasā'ti evaṃ vīsati kusalapakkhā honti.

examples.text: iti kho, bhikkhave, vīsati kusalapakkhā, vīsati akusalapakkhā, mahācattārīsako dhammapariyāyo pavattito appaṭivattiyo samaṇena vā brāhmaṇena vā devena vā mārena vā brahmunā vā kenaci vā lokasmiṃ.

22643.meaning1: connected with the beneficial; siding with the skillful
22643.meaning2: practice belonging to the group of good qualities
22643.meaningLit: on the side of the wholesome

examples.text: ye keci, bhikkhave, dhammā kusalā kusalabhāgiyā kusalapakkhikā, sabbe te appamādamūlakā appamādasamosaraṇā, appamādo tesaṃ dhammānaṃ aggam'akkhāyati. appamattassetaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno pāṭikaṅkhaṃ, satta bojjh'aṅge bhāvessati, satta bojjh'aṅge bahulīkarissati.

22644.meaning1: part of the wholesome; associated with what is beneficial

examples.text: ye keci, bhikkhave, dhammā kusalā kusalabhāgiyā kusalapakkhikā, sabbe te appamādamūlakā appamādasamosaraṇā, appamādo tesaṃ dhammānaṃ aggam'akkhāyati. appamattass'etaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno pāṭikaṅkhaṃ, satta bojjh'aṅge bhāvessati, satta bojjh'aṅge bahulīkarissati.
tīṇ'imāni, bhikkhave, kusalamūlāni. katamāni tīṇi? alobho kusalamūlaṃ, adoso kusalamūlaṃ, amoho kusalamūlaṃ.
yadapi, bhikkhave, alobho tadapi kusalamūlaṃ. yadapi aluddho abhisaṅkharoti kāyena vācāya manasā tadapi kusalaṃ.

22647.meaning1: asks after another's health; asks how are you?

22648.meaning1: heap of the wholesome; pile of benefit

examples.text: kusalarāsī'ti, bhikkhave, vadamāno cattāro satipaṭṭhāne sammā vadamāno vadeyya. kevalo h'āyaṃ, bhikkhave, kusalarāsi, yadidaṃ, cattāro satipaṭṭhānā.

22649.meaningLit: discourse on the heap of wholesome

examples.text: tayo kusalasaṅkappā, nekkhammasaṅkappo, abyāpādasaṅkappo, avihiṃsāsaṅkappo.

22651.meaning1: what is considered good; what is considered beneficial

examples.text: siyā kho pana te, nigrodha, evam'assa, ye no dhammā kusalā kusalasaṅkhātā sācariyakānaṃ, tehi vivecetu'kāmo samaṇo gotamo evam'āhā'ti. na kho pan'etaṃ, nigrodha, evaṃ daṭṭhabbaṃ. kusalā c'eva vo te dhammā hontu kusalasaṅkhātā ca sācariyakānaṃ.
tisso kusalasaññā, nekkhammasaññā, abyāpādasaññā, avihiṃsāsaññā.

22653.commentary: (DNa) catupārisuddhisīlena sīlavā, taṃ pana sīlaṃ ariyaṃ uttamaṃ parisuddhaṃ. ten'āha, ariyasīlī'ti. tadetaṃ anavajj'aṭṭhena kusalaṃ. ten'āha, kusalasīlī'ti. kusalasīlenā'ti idam'assa vevacanaṃ.

examples.text: samaṇo khalu, bho, gotamo sīlavā ariyasīlī kusalasīlī kusalasīlena samannāgato

yam'pi, bhante, bhagavā sīlavā vuddhasīlo ariyasīlo kusalasīlo kusalasīlena samannāgato, idam'pi kho ahaṃ, bhante, atthavasaṃ sampassamāno bhagavati evarūpaṃ paramanipaccakāraṃ karomi, mett'ūpahāraṃ upadaṃsemi.

22654.meaning1: skilled in ethical conduct; conducting oneself skilfully
22654.commentary: (MNa) tadeva anavajj'aṭṭhena kusalaṃ, ten'āha kusalasīlī'ti. kusalena sīlenā'ti idam'assa vevacanaṃ.

examples.text: samaṇo khalu, bho, gotamo sīlavā ariyasīlī kusalasīlī kusalena sīlena samannāgato

22656.meaning1: achieving good; attaining what is skilful
22656.commentary: (DNa) kusalass'ādhigamāyā'ti maggakusalassa c'eva phalakusalassa ca adhigam'atthāya. ubhayam'pi h'etaṃ anavajj'aṭṭhena khem'aṭṭhena vā kusalam'eva.

examples.text: taṃ kiṃ maññanti, bhonto devā tāvatiṃsā, yāva supaññattā c'ime tena bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena cattāro satipaṭṭhānā paññattā kusalass'ādhigamāya.

22657.meaning1: doing good deeds; undertaking skilful actions; making merit
22657.meaning2: to be committed to the good

examples.text: sabbapāpassa akaraṇaṃ, kusalass'ūpasampadā, sacittapariyodapanaṃ, etaṃ buddhāna sāsanaṃ.

22658.meaning1: healthy thinking; wholesome thought; skilful thinking

examples.text: tayo'me, bhikkhave, kusalavitakkā anandhakaraṇā cakkhukaraṇā ñāṇakaraṇā paññāvuddhikā avighātapakkhikā nibbānasaṃvattanikā. katame tayo?

22659.meaning1: good result of actions; wholesome fruit of deeds
22659.meaning2: fruit of result of good action

22660.meaning1: asked how one is; enquired about one's health

examples.text: tuvañ'ca bhante anukampakaṃ viduṃ, upecca vandiṃ kusalañ'ca pucchisaṃ, tato te ucchussa adāsi khaṇḍikaṃ, pasannacitā atulāya pītiyā'ti.

22661.grammar: masc pl, sometimes derog, from kusala

examples.text: sakaṃ sakaṃ diṭṭhiparibbasānā, viggayha nānā kusalā vadanti, yo evaṃ jānāti sa vedi dhammaṃ, idaṃ paṭikkosam'akevalī so.
taṃ vā'pi ganthaṃ kusalā vadanti, yaṃ nissito passati hīnam'aññaṃ, tasmā hi diṭṭhaṃ va sutaṃ mutaṃ vā, sīlabbataṃ bhikkhu na nissayeyya.

22662.meaning2: right practices or actions; good conduct; virtues; factors conducing to well-being

22663.meaning1: skilful and unskilful; wholesome and unwholesome; good and bad

examples.text: ko ca, bhikkhave, āhāro anuppannassa vā dhammavicayasambojjh'aṅgassa uppādāya, uppannassa vā dhammavicayasambojjh'aṅgassa bhāvanāya pāripūriyā? atthi, bhikkhave, kusal'ākusalā dhammā, sāvajj'ānavajjā dhammā, hīnapaṇītā dhammā, kaṇhasukkasappaṭibhāgā dhammā.

22664.meaning1: what is skilful and what is unskilful; what is wholesome and what is unwholesome; what is good and what is bad

examples.text: dīgharatt'āhaṃ bhotā gotamena sahakathī. sādhu me bhavaṃ gotamo saṃkhittena kusal'ākusalaṃ desetū'ti.

22665.meaning1: wholesome and unwholesome action; skilful and unskilful deeds

22666.meaning1: what is called good and bad intention

22667.meaning1: seeking what is good; (comm) seeking omniscience
22667.commentary: (DNa) kiṃ kusal'ānuesī'ti kiṃ kusalan'ti anuesanto pariyesanto. tattha, kiṃ kusalan'ti sabbaññutaññāṇaṃ adhippetaṃ, taṃ gavesanto'ti attho.

examples.text: paradhammikānam'pi na santaseyya, disvā'pi tesaṃ bahubheravāni, ath'āparāni abhisambhaveyya, parissayāni kusal'ānuesī.

22668.meaning1: outflow of good; wholesome result; stream of merit
22668.meaning2: outflow of good; issue of good

examples.text: ayaṃ paṭhamo puññ'ābhisando kusal'ābhisando sukhass'āhāro.

22669.meaning1: with wholesome outcomes; with good future results

examples.text: ekam'pi ce pāṇam'aduṭṭhacitto, mettāyati kusalī tena hoti, sabbe ca pāṇe manas'ānukampī, pahūtamariyo pakaroti puññaṃ.

22672.commentary: (SNa) kusalan'ti idaṃ vacanaṃ imassa atthī'ti kusalī, tesaṃ therānaṃ tvaṃ kusalaṃ anavajjaṃ bhāsasi, thomesi pasaṃsasi, paṇḍito'si devaputtā'ti vadati.

examples.text: kusalī bhāsasī tesaṃ, mārapāsappahāyinaṃ, kassa te dhammam'aññāya, acchiduṃ bhavabandhanan'ti.

22674.meaning2: (comm) coming from what is good, resulting from what is good; producing good in the future

22675.meaning1: connected with the wholesome; to do with the skilful
22675.commentary: (ANa) dān'ādiupakaraṇānaṃ asampattiyā uppajjamānaṃ pana kusal'ūpasaṃhitaṃ dukkhaṃ domanassan'ti

examples.text: idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno yaṃ nimittaṃ āgamma yaṃ nimittaṃ manasikaroto uppajjanti pāpakā akusalā vitakkā chand'ūpasaṃhitā'pi dos'ūpasaṃhitā'pi moh'ūpasaṃhitā'pi, tena, bhikkhave, bhikkhunā tamhā nimittā aññaṃ nimittaṃ manasi kātabbaṃ kusal'ūpasaṃhitaṃ.

yam'pi'ssa kusal'ūpasaṃhitaṃ dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ, tam'pi'ssa tasmiṃ samaye na hoti. yasmiṃ, bhante, samaye ariyasāvako pavivekaṃ pītiṃ upasampajja viharati, imāni'ssa pañca ṭhānāni tasmiṃ samaye na hontī'ti.

22676.meaning2: casting or dropping of markers (on shares of material to be distributed)

22677.meaning1: name of the royal capital of king Mahāsudassana

examples.text: bhūtapubb'āhaṃ, bhikkhu, rājā ahosiṃ khattiyo muddh'āvasitto. tassa mayhaṃ, bhikkhu, rañño sato khattiyassa muddh'āvasittassa caturāsītinagarasahassāni ahesuṃ kusāvatī rājadhānippamukhāni.
tesaṃ kho pana, bhikkhu, caturāsītiyā nagarasahassānaṃ ekaññ'eva taṃ nagaraṃ hoti yam'ahaṃ tena samayena ajjhāvasāmi, kusāvatī rājadhānī.

22678.meaning1: headed by Kusāvatī, the royal capital
22678.meaning2: headed by Kusāvatī, the royal capital
22678.commentary: (DNa) kusāvatī-rājadhāni-ppamukhānī'ti kusāvatī rājadhānī tesaṃ nagarānaṃ pamukhā sabbaseṭṭhā'ti attho.

examples.text: rañño, ānanda, mahāsudassanassa caturāsīti nagarasahassāni ahesuṃ kusāvatī-rājadhāni-ppamukhāni

22679.commentary: (DNa) kusāvatī-rājadhāni-ppamukhānī'ti kusāvatī rājadhānī tesaṃ nagarānaṃ pamukhā sabbaseṭṭhā'ti attho.

examples.text: rañño, ānanda, mahāsudassanassa caturāsīti nagarasahassāni ahesuṃ kusāvatī-rājadhāni-ppamukhāni, caturāsīti pāsādasahassāni ahesuṃ dhammapāsādappamukhāni, caturāsīti kūṭ'āgārasahassāni ahesuṃ mahāviyūha-kūṭ'āgāra-ppamukhāni
pañca avahārā, theyy'āvahāro, pasayh'āvahāro, parikapp'āvahāro, paṭicchann'āvahāro, kus'āvahāro.

22681.meaning2: piece of cloth (part of a monk's robe)

22682.commentary: (DNa) tassa ca nagarā ahu antalikkhe sumāpitā'ti tassa rañño ākāse suṭṭhu māpitā ete āṭānāṭ'ādikā nagarā ahesuṃ, nagarāni bhaviṃsū'ti attho. ekañ'hi'ssa nagaraṃ āṭānāṭā nāma āsi, ekaṃ kusināṭā nāma, ekaṃ parakusināṭā nāma, ekaṃ nāṭasūriyā nāma, ekaṃ parakusiṭanāṭā nāma.

examples.text: tassa ca nagarā ahu, antalikkhe sumāpitā, āṭānāṭā kusināṭā parakusināṭā, nāṭasuriyā parakusiṭanāṭā.

22687.meaning1: name of a Mallan town; small town where the Buddha passed away

examples.text: assosuṃ kho pāveyyakā mallā bhagavā kira kusinārāyaṃ parinibbuto'ti
subh'ānupassiṃ viharantaṃ, indriyesu asaṃvutaṃ, bhojanamhi c'āmattaññuṃ, kusītaṃ hīnavīriyaṃ, taṃ ve pasahati māro, vāto rukkhaṃ'va dubbalaṃ.
āraddhavīriyassāyaṃ dhammo n'āyaṃ dhammo kusītassa

22691.meaning1: due to a lazy person; owing to a lethargic person
22691.commentary: (ITIa) evaṃ kusītaṃ āgamma, sādhujīvī'pi sīdatī'ti evam'eva kusītaṃ vīriy'ārambharahitaṃ kilesavasikaṃ puggalaṃ nissāya tena katasaṃsaggo sādhujīvī'pi parisuddh'ājīvo parisuddhasīlo'pi samāno hīnasaṃsaggato uppannehi kāmavitakk'ādīhi khajjamāno pāraṃ gantuṃ asamattho saṃsār'aṇṇave'y'eva sīdati.

examples.text: evaṃ kusītam'āgamma, sādhujīvi'pi sīdati, tasmā taṃ parivajjeyya, kusītaṃ hīnavīriyaṃ.

22694.meaning1: grounds for laziness; basis for sloth
22694.commentary: (ANa) kusītavatthūnī'ti kusītassa alasassa vatthūni patiṭṭhā, kosajjakāraṇānī'ti attho.

examples.text: aṭṭh'imāni, bhikkhave, kusītavatthūni. katamāni aṭṭha?

22695.meaning1: due to the defilement of laziness and low effort

examples.text: ye kho keci samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā kusītā hīnavīriyā araññavanapatthāni pantāni sen'āsanāni paṭisevanti, kusītahīnavīriyasandosahetu have te bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā akusalaṃ bhayabheravaṃ avhāyanti.

22698.commentary: (ANt) khuddakasobbhā kusubbhā okārassa ukāraṃ katvā. yattha upari unnatappadesato udakaṃ āgantvā tiṭṭhati c'eva sandati ca, te kusubbhā khuddaka-āvāṭā.

examples.text: pabbata-kandara-padara-sākhā-paripūrā kusubbhe paripūrenti, kusubbhā paripūrā mahāsobbhe paripūrenti, mahāsobbhā paripūrā, kunnadiyo paripūrenti, kunnadiyo paripūrā mahānadiyo paripūrenti, mahānadiyo paripūrā mahāsamuddaṃ paripūrenti

22699.commentary: (THIa) kusumarajena samuṭṭhitā dumā'ti ime rukkhā mandavātena samuṭṭhahamāna-kusumareṇu-jātena attano kusumarajena sayaṃ samuṭṭhitā viya hutvā samantato surabhī vāyanti.

examples.text: madhurañ'ca pavanti sabbaso, kusumarajena samuṭṭhitā dumā, paṭhamavasanto sukho utu, ehi ramāma supupphite vane.
